headline: Casualties Surge in Callahan's Passage as Northern Battles Intensify
war_summary: Callahan's Passage has erupted into a massive theater of attrition over the past three hours, where casualty rates have surged past nineteen hundred men per hour amidst an accelerating influx of fresh enlistments. Weathered Expanse remains in severe upheaval, recording seven base transitions in the last two hours as Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch change hands and four positions lie gutted in no-man's-land. Heavy combat continues to churn through Marban Hollow and Linn of Mercy, where repeated clashes over Checkpoint Bua, Oster Wall, and Outwich Ranch produce ongoing base turnover. Further west, Mooring County experienced a sudden burst of contestation at The Wind Hills with four recent control changes, while Nevish Line and Stonecradle endure persistent frontline strain despite localized cooling in casualty tempos. Outlying coastal and island sectors, including Kuura Strand and Godcrofts, have largely quieted as the fighting concentrates along these central and northern axes.
